# one JSON line: the rome partition queue and the CPU use of its nodes
function esc(s)
    s = replace(s, "\\" => "\\\\", "\"" => "\\\"", "\n" => "\\n", "\r" => "", "\t" => "\\t")
    return "\"" * s * "\""
end
function run_out(cmd)
    out = IOBuffer(); err = IOBuffer()
    try
        run(pipeline(ignorestatus(cmd), stdout = out, stderr = err))
    catch e
        return "ERROR: " * sprint(showerror, e)
    end
    return String(take!(out)) * (position(err) > 0 ? "\n[stderr]\n" * String(take!(err)) : "")
end
parts = Pair{String,String}[]
push!(parts, "squeue_rome" => run_out(`squeue -p rome -o "%.10i %.8u %.24j %.2t %.10M %.10l %.4C %.8m %R" -S "-t,i"`))
push!(parts, "nodes" => run_out(`sinfo -p rome -N -o "%N %T %C %m %e"`))
push!(parts, "job_2098965" => run_out(`squeue -j 2098965 -o "%.10i %.2t %.10M %R %S"`))
println("{" * join(["$(esc(k)):$(esc(v))" for (k, v) in parts], ",") * "}")
